rules.note: A failure path is one throw, one reject, or one return of an error value (`{ ok: false }`, `null`, `undefined` on a checked condition): a single throw behind a condition with several `||` operands is one path, reached when any operand is tripped. Only the paths this body DECLARES count; a callee that may throw is not this function's path unless the body catches and re-reports it. Judge what a test's body does, not what its title says: a test whose title claims a failure but whose body never trips $NAME's guard reaches nothing, and a test whose title is about something else but whose body passes the bad input and asserts the throw reaches it. The related tests are excerpts, so a call to $NAME counts even when the assertion around it was cut; but a call with ordinary input does not reach a guard that ordinary input never trips, and a mention of $NAME only in an import reaches nothing. Returning the input unchanged, or a default, when a condition is not met is a fallback and not a failure path: nothing is refused and nothing reports an error.

pub fn serialize_checkpoint_delivery_statement(
  statement : CheckpointDeliveryStatement,
) -> String {
  let buffer = StringBuilder::new()
  let boundary = statement.boundary
  delivery_append_field(buffer, "checkpoint-delivery-auth-v1")
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.protocol_version.to_string())
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.purpose)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.manifest_digest.0)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.scope_id)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.unit_id)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.destination_id)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.epoch.to_string())
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.previous_checkpoint.0)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.checkpoint_digest.0)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.canonical_envelope)
  buffer.to_string()
}

pub fn verify_macro_checkpoint_micro(
  hasher : &@bft.Hasher,
  checkpoint : MacroCheckpoint,
  micro : MicroCheckpoint,
  proof : @merkle.MerkleProof,
) -> Bool {
  if checkpoint.micro_checkpoint_count <= 0 ||
    checkpoint.ends_at_ms <= checkpoint.starts_at_ms ||
    proof.leaf_count != checkpoint.micro_checkpoint_count ||
    proof.leaf_index != micro.micro_index ||
    macro_checkpoint_digest(hasher, checkpoint) != checkpoint.digest ||
    micro_checkpoint_digest(hasher, micro) != micro.digest ||
    micro.scope_id != checkpoint.scope_id ||
    micro.macro_epoch != checkpoint.epoch ||
    micro.starts_at_ms < checkpoint.starts_at_ms ||
    micro.ends_at_ms > checkpoint.ends_at_ms ||
    micro.ends_at_ms <= micro.starts_at_ms {
    return false
  }
  @merkle.verify_inclusion(
    hasher,
    serialize_micro_checkpoint(micro),
    checkpoint.micro_root,
    proof,
  )
}

pub fn verify_macro_checkpoint_event(
  hasher : &@bft.Hasher,
  checkpoint : MacroCheckpoint,
  canonical_payload : String,
  proof : LayeredEventProof,
) -> Bool {
  verify_micro_checkpoint_event(
    hasher,
    proof.micro_checkpoint,
    canonical_payload,
    proof.event_proof,
  ) &&
  verify_macro_checkpoint_micro(
    hasher,
    checkpoint,
    proof.micro_checkpoint,
    proof.micro_proof,
  )
}

  self : PlayerLocalSealPlan,
) -> PlayerLocalSealWriteSet {
  let runtime_plan = self.runtime_plan

    expected_revision: self.expected_revision,
    expected_snapshot: runtime_plan.expected_snapshot(),
    checkpoint: runtime_plan.checkpoint(),
    next_head: runtime_plan.next_head(),
    outbox_entries: runtime_plan

    consumed_closure: self.consumed_closure,
    next_outbox_entry_count: runtime_plan.next_outbox_entry_count(),
    next_created_order: runtime_plan.next_created_order(),
  }
}

pub fn verify_macro_checkpoint_micro(
  hasher : &@bft.Hasher,
  checkpoint : MacroCheckpoint,
  micro : MicroCheckpoint,
  proof : @merkle.MerkleProof,
) -> Bool {
  if checkpoint.micro_checkpoint_count <= 0 ||
    checkpoint.ends_at_ms <= checkpoint.starts_at_ms ||
    proof.leaf_count != checkpoint.micro_checkpoint_count ||
    proof.leaf_index != micro.micro_index ||
    macro_checkpoint_digest(hasher, checkpoint) != checkpoint.digest ||
    micro_checkpoint_digest(hasher, micro) != micro.digest ||
    micro.scope_id != checkpoint.scope_id ||
    micro.macro_epoch != checkpoint.epoch ||
    micro.starts_at_ms < checkpoint.starts_at_ms ||
    micro.ends_at_ms > checkpoint.ends_at_ms ||
    micro.ends_at_ms <= micro.starts_at_ms {
    return false
  }
  @merkle.verify_inclusion(
    hasher,
    serialize_micro_checkpoint(micro),
    checkpoint.micro_root,
    proof,
  )
}

pub fn serialize_checkpoint_delivery_statement(
  statement : CheckpointDeliveryStatement,
) -> String {
  let buffer = StringBuilder::new()
  let boundary = statement.boundary
  delivery_append_field(buffer, "checkpoint-delivery-auth-v1")
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.protocol_version.to_string())
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.purpose)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.manifest_digest.0)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.scope_id)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, boundary.unit_id)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.destination_id)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.epoch.to_string())
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.previous_checkpoint.0)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.checkpoint_digest.0)
  delivery_append_field(buffer, statement.canonical_envelope)
  buffer.to_string()
}

pub fn verify_macro_checkpoint_micro(
  hasher : &@bft.Hasher,
  checkpoint : MacroCheckpoint,
  micro : MicroCheckpoint,
  proof : @merkle.MerkleProof,
) -> Bool {
  if checkpoint.micro_checkpoint_count <= 0 ||
    checkpoint.ends_at_ms <= checkpoint.starts_at_ms ||
    proof.leaf_count != checkpoint.micro_checkpoint_count ||
    proof.leaf_index != micro.micro_index ||
    macro_checkpoint_digest(hasher, checkpoint) != checkpoint.digest ||
    micro_checkpoint_digest(hasher, micro) != micro.digest ||
    micro.scope_id != checkpoint.scope_id ||
    micro.macro_epoch != checkpoint.epoch ||
    micro.starts_at_ms < checkpoint.starts_at_ms ||
    micro.ends_at_ms > checkpoint.ends_at_ms ||
    micro.ends_at_ms <= micro.starts_at_ms {
    return false
  }
  @merkle.verify_inclusion(
    hasher,
    serialize_micro_checkpoint(micro),
    checkpoint.micro_root,
    proof,
  )
}

pub fn verify_macro_checkpoint_event(
  hasher : &@bft.Hasher,
  checkpoint : MacroCheckpoint,
  canonical_payload : String,
  proof : LayeredEventProof,
) -> Bool {
  verify_micro_checkpoint_event(
    hasher,
    proof.micro_checkpoint,
    canonical_payload,
    proof.event_proof,
  ) &&
  verify_macro_checkpoint_micro(
    hasher,
    checkpoint,
    proof.micro_checkpoint,
    proof.micro_proof,
  )
}
